title: session-start.sh header miscounts its own report and cites a 'HANDOVER trap 11' that does not exist
claim: session-start.sh's header says the behind-main lines are 'the fifth and sixth lines' and the trap 'the other three could not see', but report() prints them as lines 4 and 5 and the WHY THESE list carries four other items (mismatches=3). Its 'HANDOVER trap 11' citation resolves to nothing: dev/programme/HANDOVER.md's traps are unnumbered bullets (handover_trap_11_found=0).
mechanism: The toolchain item and its line were added after the sentence was written; the ordinals and count were not re-derived.

evidence.machine: box B12, x86_64 Intel Xeon @ 2.10GHz, 4 vCPU, Python 3.14.7, node v22.23.4
evidence.contention_note: shared box during fan-out; a count, contention-immune

perturbation.change: --perturb: insert one printf line in report() before 'behind main:' in the hook copy

metric_definition: mismatches = (behind_pos != 5) + (tip_pos != 6) + (other WHY-THESE items != 3), positions read from report()'s real output
phenomenon_property: Every ordinal or count a hook comment states about the hook's own output equals what the hook prints.
proposed_fix_scope: session-start.sh lines 36-37: 'The fourth and fifth lines, and the trap the other four could not see' (or drop the ordinals); cite the shallow-clone trap by its words ('A shallow clone turns "commits ahead" into fiction') instead of 'trap 11'
